purpose: Present a verified property chronology as a citizen-friendly timeline with event-level evidence, legal context and limitations while enforcing privacy and access boundaries.
core_principle: TIMELINE EVENT → WHAT HAPPENED → EVIDENCE → LAW → EFFECT → LIMITATION
rules: Only approved/public-safe chronology data may be shown publicly.
Timeline order must preserve the chronology builder's date rules.
Event date, document date and registration date remain separately labelled.
A timeline event is not itself proof beyond its underlying evidence.
Legal effect is displayed only when established by the applicable legal analysis.
Missing evidence and unresolved conflicts remain visible.
Restricted documents are represented by safe summaries or official retrieval routes rather than exposed content.
Current and historical timeline views remain distinct.
hard_stops: Never fabricate an event to make the timeline continuous.
Never hide a material missing record or date conflict.
Never expose restricted/private evidence in the public viewer.
Never infer legal effect from event labels alone.
Never convert current state into historical state without historical evidence.
